description: pgx's classification against the conformance corpus (conformance/actions.json). 'adapterUnsupported' lists 'conformance' actions this adapter cannot express, each with the reason (naming the real mechanism) and the substring its thrown error must contain. 'adapterSupportedExpected' lists 'expectedUnsupported' actions this adapter deliberately translates, so they are oracle-compared instead of thrown. 'expectedUnsupportedMessages' pins the throw message for every 'expectedUnsupported' action it does not promote, and 'nullRepresentationOmittedMessages' for every 'nullRepresentationOmitted' action. validate-corpus.sh checks all four against the corpus; the harness refuses to run with a message missing.
